_comment: Copy to /opt/lumpad/server/data/llm.json to add providers or change routes. Without this file only DeepSeek is used, as today. Keys are NOT stored here: key_env names an environment variable in /opt/lumpad/.env.v2. Prices (per million tokens) are yours to fill in from the provider's price page; with prices the monthly cap counts the provider's spend, without them its calls are limited by max_calls_per_day instead.
